verdict.rationale: A community user reports that vue-cli, alongside the official vuex and vue-router, lets them scaffold projects easily, which points to an official Vue CLI for project creation. First-party docs here are only bare 'Tooling Guide' and 'Quick Start' titles with no CLI detail, and nothing shows the CLI supports AI-native or agentic workflows. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the official CLI's commands and current status, AI- or agent-oriented CLI features (e.g. machine-readable output, non-interactive agent use), independent hands-on corroboration from recent sources.
